fullPassage: Dear Customer Service, I am writing in regard to my magazine subscription. Currently, I have just over a year to go on my subscription to Economy Tomorrow and would like to continue my subscription as I have enjoyed the magazine for many years. Unfortunately, due to my bad eyesight, I have trouble reading your magazine. My doctor has told me that I need to look for large print magazines and books. Dear Customer Service, I am writing in regard to my magazine subscription. Currently, I have just over a year to go on my subscription to Economy Tomorrow and would like to continue my subscription as I have enjoyed the magazine for many years.

(A) My doctor has told me that I need to look for large print magazines and books. I'd like to know whether there's a large print version of your magazine.

(B) Unfortunately, due to my bad eyesight, I have trouble reading your magazine.

(C) Please contact me if this is something you offer. Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Sincerely, Martin Gray

det.korean: 구독 상황 → (B) 시력 문제 → (A) 의사 조언+문의 → (C) 연락 요청+마무리
det.analysis:
① (B) — (A) — (C): 문제 → 대안 문의 → 마무리 ←정답
② (A) — (B) — (C): 의사 언급이 문제 제시 전 부자연
③ (B) — (C) — (A): 마무리 뒤 문의 부자연
④ (C) — (A) — (B): 마무리가 먼저 올 수 없음
det.tip: bad eyesight → doctor advice → contact me
